title: koi up --json
description: What koi up --json prints once the build has finished. koi exits 0 when status is running and 1 when it is failed.

schemaVersion.description: Changes only when koi removes a field or changes what one means. Adding an optional field keeps it.

label.description: The preview's name, the first label of its hostname.

status.description: How the build koi up asked for ended: running once it deployed, failed when it did not. It does not say whether the container is up now.

commit.description: What koi built: for a pull request, the merge of it into its base, whose parents are in merge, or with --head the head as pushed; for a working tree, its HEAD commit. The merge is GitHub's (refs/pull/N/merge), or one koi made itself from the same two parents when GitHub's stayed out of date; koi makes its own the same way every time, so the parents give the commit.

merge.description: The parents of the merge in commit, when koi built a merge of a pull request. Absent for a working tree and with --head.

deployment.description: The identity of the deployment koid has on record for the preview as koi up ended, when it has one: absent after a first build that failed. It says nothing about whether the preview's container is running. After a failed rebuild it can be the previous deployment, so a caller compares deployment.commit with commit before it trusts the preview.

loginKey.description: For apps with a sign-in, the key a reviewer types to get in. A secret: never copy it into evidence or logs.

keysUrl.description: The preview's keys page, where a reviewer registers provider keys and gets koi tokens that work only in this preview.

error.description: Why the build failed, when status is failed.

comment.description: With --comment, the address of the pull request comment koi posted or updated.
